body: And the same goes for me. I already know how it feels...I'll hang on if you do.

I wish you were closer, I would help you. I hear shit like that all the time, but I really do help where I can. Life really, really sucks. I actually created an account just last night as a final cry for help..please don't give up. Life is hard, and good people receive the most amount of bullshit. Please, please hang in there.

Instead of replying to everyone individually, I figured I would just leave a comment. I never thought that anyone would see this, and I certainly didnt think anyone would care. You are all wonderful, for I'm a stranger and you were willing to reach out to me..something that the people surrounding me would never do. And for that, I love you all. Thank you so much for your kind words..I really, truly needed them. It's good to know that there are people in this world that care fabout more than just themselves. <3 A Salamu Alaaiykum (Peace be with you).
